title: PURSUE N170 Face Perception
description: EEG dataset from the PURSUE project of a face perception task designed to elicit the N170 event-related potential. Data were collected from participants at three primarily undergraduate institutions in Southern California, Massachusetts, and Virginia during 2017 and 2018. The task follows the ERP CORE paradigm, and the dataset includes participant race information.
methods_description: Face perception task following the ERP CORE N170 paradigm, with EEG recorded from participants at three undergraduate institutions in 2017 and 2018. Task details are provided in the ERP CORE supplementary materials.
